top_signals.title: Wilkinson: Biggest Global Energy Shock in 40 Years
top_signals.summary: Oil slipped as traders weigh a potential energy ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia while the IEA urged members to speed up pledged diesel releases. This comes after hostilities escalated across the Middle East, with strikes by Houthis on Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh airport. Angela Wilkinson, Secretary General at the World Energy Council spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East and Africa to discuss the pressures on the energy markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

All that and more, as you head to the office in the Gulf, pause for lunch in Hong Kong, or start your day in London or Johannesburg.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Why China is importing a record amount of gold — and what it means for prices
top_signals.summary: Beijing’s push to diversify away from the dollar and Chinese households’ search for a safe place to put their savings has fueled China’s record gold buying.
